ruleDefinitions.name: Potential ShellDispatch.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "ShellDispatch.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\ShellDispatch\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
